paite: Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawmnih-le-sagih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Amaziah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Uzziah / (2 Kro 26.1-23)

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-guk a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nih alal a; anu min Jekoliah, Jerusalem mi ahi.
Apa Amaziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Himahleh mun sangte lakmang ahi tuan kei. Mun sangte ah mite kithoih lailai in, gimlim ahal lai uhi.
TOUPA'N kumpipa agawt a, huchi in asih ni pha in aphak a, inn tuam ah atengta hi. Kumpipa tapa Jotham in agam ua mite vai hawmsak in inkuan tung a heutu in a-om hi.
Huchi in Azariah tanchin dangte athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Azariah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; huchi in asik in atapa Jotham alalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmthum-le-giat alal kum in Jeroboam tapa Zakariah Israelte tung ah Samaria ah kha guk alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Zakariah

paite: Apute hih mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil ahihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei hi.
Jabesh tapa Shallum in aguk in thah asawm a, mipite ma ah asual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
Huchi in Zakariah tanchin dangte bel ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
Huai bel ToUPA'N Jehu kiang a, "Na tapate suan lina tan in Israelte laltutphah ah atu ding uh," chih thu agen hi. Huchi in huai bang geih ahong hita hi.
Judah kumpipa Uzziah kum sawmthum-le-kua alal kum in Jabesh tapa Shallum alal pan a; Samaria ah kha khat sung alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Shallum

paite: Tirzah a pan Gadi tapa Menahem ahohtou a, Samaria ah ahoh a, Samaria ah Jabesh tapa Shallum asual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
Huchi in Shallum tanchin dangte, aguksawmna thute ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
Huchi in Menahem in Tirzah a pan Tiphsah leh asung a om tengteng leh agamte asual a; amah a dia akihon louh ziak un asual a; huai ah naupai lai numei tengteng apikkek hi.
Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmthum-le-kua alal kum in Gadi tapa Menahem Israelte tung ah alal pan a, Samaria ah kum sawm alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Menahem

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna in adamsung apaisan kei hi.
Assuria kumpipa Pul in agam ahong sual a; gam aneihkippih theihna ding in Menahem in Pul dangka talent sangkhat apia hi.
Menahem in Assuria kumpipa piak ding in Israel mi nei zou tengteng lak ah dangka shekel sawmnga chiat akhon a; huchi in Assuria kumpipa apai nawn a, huai gam ah ataam nilouh kei hi.
Menahem tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Menahem api-le-pute kiang ah ihmuta a; asik in atapa Pekahiah alal hi.
Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmnga alal kum in Israelte tung ah Samaria ah Menahem tapa Pekahiah alal pan a, kum nih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Pekahiah

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei hi.
Asepaih heutu Remaliah tapa Pekah in amah aguksawm a, Samaria a kumpipa' inn a kulh ah Argob toh, Arieh toh athatta a; akiang ah Gilead mi sawmnga toh; huchi in Pekahiah athat a, asik in alalta hi.
Huchi in Pekahiah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmnga-le-nih alal kum in Remaliah tapa Pekah Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawmnih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Pekah

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei.

Israel kumpipa Pekah lal lai in Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser in Ijon, Abel-beth-maakah, Janoah, Kadesh, Hazor, Gilead leh Galili gamte leh Naphtali gam tengteng ala a, Assuria gam ah sal in api hi.
Elah tapa Hoshea in Remaliah tapa Pekah aguksawm a, asual a, athat a, Uzziah tapa Jotham kum sawmnih alal kum in asik in alalta hi.
Huchi in Pekah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah kum nih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Uzziah tapa Jotham alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jotham / (2 Kro 27.1-9)

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk alal a; anu min Jerusha, Zadok tanu ahi.
Apa Uzziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Himahleh mun sangte hihmang ahi tuan kei; mun sangte ah mite'n kithoih in, gimlim ahal lai uhi. TOUPA' inn kongpi saknungzaw abawlhoih hi.
Huchi in Jotham tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huai lai in Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Remulia tapa Pekah Judate sual ding in TOUPA'N asawl pan hi.
Jotham api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-pute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahaz alalta hi.
